issue_request: FHIR-43472 reported that CodeableConcept and CodeableReference use the FHIR spelling "Codeable" rather than dictionary "Codable". The Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6 rejected renaming normative datatypes and instead called for an explanatory note that the spelling is long-standing and accepted by the community.
initial_application: Current source already includes d18b13713fa, which added the explanatory note for both CodeableConcept and CodeableReference in source/help.html, followed by 1cae470f393 correcting the inherited "accpeted" typo to "accepted". A separate side-branch commit 08c5139c39 added a typo-bearing note only to source/datatypes.html for CodeableConcept and is not the current application path.
additional_context: source/help.html is the Glossary linked from source/documentation.html. source/fhir.ini maps CodeableConcept to the datatypes page by the default type-page rule and CodeableReference to references.html; those active pages do not contradict the glossary note or attempt a rename. Confluence FHIR-I WGM minutes confirm the 19-0-0 Not Persuasive with Modification vote. Targeted Zulip search and Jira neighborhood search found no related or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source hunk was needed. The current combined branch already represents the approved non-renaming decision and the corrected explanatory note for both requested terms, so this commit only records the reconciliation audit trail.
